reason: README shows a ChatSampler demo; Gemma checkpoints are public on gs://gemma-data (no login) and a small 270M variant runs on CPU via JAX.
demo: README Examples: gm.text.ChatSampler with gm.ckpts.load_params (using the small Gemma3 270M IT variant instead of Gemma 4 E4B)
goal: Install the gemma package from the clone at /work/gemma with JAX for CPU, and make a text-only chat work with the official ChatSampler API. Use model gm.nn.Gemma3_270M() with params from gm.ckpts.load_params(gm.ckpts.CheckpointPath.GEMMA3_270M_IT), which downloads from the public gs://gemma-data bucket. Then call sampler.chat('What is the capital of France?') and get a sensible text answer. Put whatever environment activation is needed in /work/env.sh.
check: A Python script using gm.nn.Gemma3_270M, load_params(GEMMA3_270M_IT) and ChatSampler.chat generates a non-empty text answer to a factual question, and a second multi-turn call also returns text.
